people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

translations.web: From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my dispersed people, will bring my offering.
translations.bsb: From beyond the rivers of Cush My worshipers, My scattered people, will bring Me an offering.
translations.kjv: From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants, even the daughter of my dispersed, shall bring mine offering.
